verses.1: On the eighth day, Moses called upon Aaron and his sons, as well as the elders of Israel.
verses.2: And he said to Aaron, “Take for yourself a ram as an offering for your sin. And bring it as an offering of righteousness before the LORD.”
verses.3: And to the children of Israel, I will say, “Take young goats for sinning, and also a ram and a lamb. These are fresh animals suitable for offering them as sacrifices.”
verses.4: And let there be sacrifices and offerings for the LORD’s worship. Let them be offered in silence, in the midst of smoke. For today, the LORD will be seen by you.
verses.5: And they took what Moses had commanded, and stood before the tent of meeting. All the congregation stood there, ready to worship Jehovah.
verses.6: And Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded you to do. You must do these things and show them to yourselves as a sign of the LORD’s honor.”
verses.7: And Moses said to Aaron, “Go to the altar and perform your sacrifices. Offer them as offerings for yourself and for the people. Perform the sacrifices for the people, just as the LORD has commanded.”
verses.8: And Aaron came forward to the altar, and he sacrificed the goat of the sin.
verses.9: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him. He poured it on his forehead, and then he placed the blood on the horns of the altar. The blood was also poured into the trench around the altar.
verses.10: And the blood, along with the ashes and all that remains from sin, was used to burn at the altar, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.11: And the tent and all its furnishings were burned by fire from outside the camp.
verses.12: And he slaughtered the sheep. Then, the sons of Aaron found blood on it. They poured that blood around the altar.
verses.13: And they brought her up to him for healing. They also cut off his head and placed it on the cross.
verses.14: And he washed the leavings of the slaughter and the bloodstains away. Then he dried the wet ground.
verses.15: And he brought the offering from the people. He took the skin of the animal that was used as an offering, and he slaughtered it. Then he sacrificed it first.
verses.16: And he brought the offering forward and carried it out according to the law.
verses.17: And he brought the offering forward, and filled his hands with it. Then he placed it on the altar, right beside the entrance to the sanctuary.
verses.18: And he slaughtered the ram as an offering for the sacrifices. The sons of Aaron found the blood there, and they poured it on the altar around it.
verses.19: And the milk from the cows, as well as from the sheep and goats. Also, all kinds of dairy products and whatever else that can be used as milk.
verses.20: They poured the milk over the breasts, and they cooled the milk that had been heated.
verses.21: And Aaron raised the censers and the right hand, as Moses had commanded.
verses.22: And Aaron raised his hands towards the people. He blessed them. Then he descended from the place of sin and holiness.
verses.23: And Moses and Aaron went to the tent of meeting. They went out and blessed the people. They saw the glory of God before all the people.
verses.24: And fire came out from before the LORD. It consumed the offerings and the milk. All the people saw this, and they fell down before it.
